text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely comprehensive feature set, aiming to be an 'all-in-one' solution.",
    "High degree of customization and flexibility to adapt to various workflows.",
    "Multiple views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, etc.) are readily available for diverse preferences.",
    "Strong collaboration features for team communication and project tracking.",
    "Good value for money, especially given the extensive functionality.",
    "Frequent updates and new features are regularly introduced."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features and options.",
    "Can feel overwhelming and complex, with potential for feature duplication and initial setup challenges.",
    "Performance issues, including slow loading times or occasional lag.",
    "Frequent bugs or glitches, especially after major updates.",
    "Mobile app functionality is often less robust and can be clunky.",
    "Notification system can be overwhelming or difficult to manage effectively."
  ],
  "changed": [
    "pros[2]: 'Multiple views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, etc.) are readily available for diverse preferences.' justified by '[benefit] A Board (Kanban) view tab already existed on the list next to List, so the Kanban view needed one click rather than setup.'",
    "cons[1]: 'Can feel overwhelming and complex, with potential for feature duplication and initial setup challenges.' justified by '[friction] ClickUp already has a built-in flag-style Priority on every card, so creating a custom 'Priority' dropdown gives no warning about duplicating that built-in field.' and '[friction] The new workspace was pre-filled with Project 1, Project 2 and placeholder Task 1-3 items, so my Feature X tasks ended up mixed in with demo clutter unless I spent extra steps creating a new list or deleting them.'"
  ]
}

pros: Extremely comprehensive feature set, aiming to be an 'all-in-one' solution.
High degree of customization and flexibility to adapt to various workflows.
Multiple views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, etc.) are readily available for diverse preferences.
Strong collaboration features for team communication and project tracking.
Good value for money, especially given the extensive functionality.
Frequent updates and new features are regularly introduced.
cons: Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features and options.
Can feel overwhelming and complex, with potential for feature duplication and initial setup challenges.
Performance issues, including slow loading times or occasional lag.
Frequent bugs or glitches, especially after major updates.
Mobile app functionality is often less robust and can be clunky.
Notification system can be overwhelming or difficult to manage effectively.
changed: pros[2]: 'Multiple views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, etc.) are readily available for diverse preferences.' justified by '[benefit] A Board (Kanban) view tab already existed on the list next to List, so the Kanban view needed one click rather than setup.'

cons[1]: 'Can feel overwhelming and complex, with potential for feature duplication and initial setup challenges.' justified by '[friction] ClickUp already has a built-in flag-style Priority on every card, so creating a custom 'Priority' dropdown gives no warning about duplicating that built-in field.' and '[friction] The new workspace was pre-filled with Project 1, Project 2 and placeholder Task 1-3 items, so my Feature X tasks ended up mixed in with demo clutter unless I spent extra steps creating a new list or deleting them.'
